A full process window is unaffordable. This window covers all temperatures and separator temperatures while spanning low-to-moderate pressures; it is large enough to find a feasible/cost-leading low-price candidate if the optimum is not at very high pressure, while preserving budget for optimizing candidate_13 and candidate_04 plus parity/reachability. A broader P≤300 window would leave too little budget for edge follow-up.
